title: The World's Tallest Building
content: featuring: weird elevator Last night I had a terrifying dream about what was in that dream "the world's tallest building". I'll explain what made it terrifying in a bit. I was on a trip to "Saudi Arabia." Though it was clearly a dream world version where it had almost nothing in common with the real country, save for some aesthetics. I entered a very tall building which was full of endless floor levels of markets and stores and lounge areas. I knew I had to meet someone in his office, which happened to be at the very top of the building. And to get there, I had to take the Golden Elevator. This elevator was world famous for its ridiculous paths it would take to get to rooms of the building. It would go sideways, forwards, backwards, and of course up and down. The building itself was designed as a very large, very tall, rectangular box at the base, with increasingly smaller boxes stacked on top until reaching the final box which was actually the top room. Rooms were built on the edges of the buildings, forming a shell of rooms around the elevator paths and the massive indoor shopping center. Rooms had a series of three numbers indicating their location so instead of "go to room 300" it was "go to room 300 452 891" or something like that. The top room was 100 100 100. I got in the Golden Elevator, named such because well it had over the top gold decor. And it took a nauseating series of moves up, sideways, down, back, sideways, up, forward, up, you get the idea, until I finally reached the top room. I walked in and the elevator immediately rushed off to a new location, almost causing me to fall in a hole because I was barely on the floor and the elevator shaft doors didn't close until like a minute later. The room was blue, and there were windows everywhere allowing me to see this huge city down below. The room was largely empty except for some radio equipment and a desk. The person I was supposed to meet wasn't there, and I immediately forgot he was important anyway. Here's the terrifying part, the room started to violently sway with the wind. Just out of the blue, I guess. And I got thrown all over this room. Suddenly the windows fell out and now I'm hanging on for dear life to the bars that were holding up the windows before, as the building is now whipping around with me hanging on the outside of it. And this part felt so real, for some reason. Eventually I slip up a bit, and fall. Falling. I'm going to die. This is happening. I'm dead, I died, I'm dead I died I'm dead I died...wait. Now I'm standing in the room again, at the center in front of the desk, like nothing happened. The building starts to sway slightly again. I run to the elevator and call it and fortunately it is there, I step in and somehow teleport to the ground without having to take the elevator. I start to leave the building and someone from a store walks out too and says "You have to remember this when you wake up. You HAVE to." Then I really did wake up. And I did remember it lol.
